posts.cooked:
Perhaps I should be more general, then.

 

I think it's best if people on the message boards say where any piece of information originates, rather than assuming that we're all spending hours a week keep up with the Twitch stream and so forth.  Name-checking Akash'Bhuta, which can be found on the GTG site or the wiki is not and will never be analogous to name-checking Akash'Dharsha, for which a Google search will yield the Facebook page of person who doesn't even have that exact name.  Regardless of where it originates, the barrier there is a real one.
